question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.
sql:
WITH customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(txn_date)::DATE AS earliest,
           MAX(txn_date)::DATE AS latest
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT generate_series::DATE AS cal_date
    FROM generate_series(
        (SELECT MIN(earliest) FROM customer_date_range)::DATE,
        (SELECT MAX(latest) FROM customer_date_range)::DATE,
        INTERVAL '1 day'
    )
),
customer_date_pairs AS (
    SELECT cr.customer_id, ad.cal_date
    FROM customer_date_range cr
    JOIN all_dates ad ON ad.cal_date BETWEEN cr.earliest AND cr.latest
),
daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date::DATE AS txn_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                    ELSE 0 END) AS daily_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
daily_txn_balances AS (
    SELECT cdp.customer_id,
           cdp.cal_date,
           COALESCE(dn.daily_change, 0) AS daily_change
    FROM customer_date_pairs cdp
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn 
        ON cdp.customer_id = dn.customer_id 
        AND cdp.cal_date = dn.txn_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           cal_date,
           SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) AS running_balance
    FROM daily_txn_balances
),
adjusted_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           cal_date,
           GREATEST(running_balance, 0) AS daily_balance
    FROM cumulative_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date)::DATE AS month_start,
           EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cal_date) AS month_num,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cal_date) AS year_num,
           customer_id,
           MAX(daily_balance) AS max_daily_balance
    FROM adjusted_balances
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date)::DATE, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cal_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cal_date), customer_id
)
SELECT month_start, month_num, year_num, SUM(max_daily_balance) AS monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start, month_num, year_num
ORDER BY month_start
